reviewer: AI editorial review of opened primary research, clinical-trial abstracts, and institutional guidance

feature.basis: The October 1 ICU paper supports a ten-patient retrospective forecasting result and explicitly does not measure outcomes. MASAI primary trial abstract supports higher sensitivity and interval-cancer non-inferiority, not superiority or survival. The Kenyan randomized trial supports improved notes but no significant 14-day treatment-failure difference. The Taiwan ECG primary abstract supports lower 90-day mortality for its alert-and-clinician workflow, with generalizability limited. WHO, DECIDE-AI and the 2026 evaluation framework support separating validation, workflow evaluation and clinical outcomes. FDA page supports monitoring but explicitly is not guidance. Draft keeps these distinctions.
